notes: Homonym: shares consonants מתק with H4985 ("become sweet"), a separate, unrelated Strong's entry already in this dataset -- Strong's own entry even says this root is "from H4985", but the corpus tags this occurrence (Job.24.20, "the worm shall feed sweetly on him") to 4988 specifically, distinct from H4985's own attested forms. Per the root-key superscript convention (lower Strong's number gets ¹), H4985 has been retroactively relabeled מתק¹ in this same batch and this root is מתק².
